title: 第5章 选择功法第6章 纵横剑法
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 虽然孙家在整个大陆上只不过是一个微不足道的家族，但在落云镇中还是相当强大的，功法殿并不大，但是里面的高台上放置的都是一本本古朴的功法，一眼望去不下于二十本，这让孙冰都有些目不暇接。
根据孙冰的了解，功法秘籍由高到低分为天、地、玄、黄四个等级，其中每一个等级又有上品，中品，下品之分。
至于基础剑法这种东西，在整个大陆上都流传胜广，就算是普通人也能耍上两手，根本就不算什么秘籍。
孙冰所待的地方只能算是功法殿一层，摆放的仅仅只是黄级下品的秘籍，但足以让人感到震撼了，要知道对于普通人而言，这样的秘籍甚至能够让他们当做传家宝一代一代传承下去了。
可想而知孙家的家大业大，别人视若珍宝，在孙家，只要是人都能够进来免费学习一门，不过需要留意的是，万万不可传给他人，否则不死不休。
孙冰也曾听说，孙家最为高深的秘籍是一门玄级上品的功法，只不过那需要最纯正的血统才能够学习，支脉都不一定能够观看，更别说那些普通的下人了。
当然了，孙冰对于那门功法倒没有什么奢求，他此行前来最主要的目的是寻找一剑法学习，毕竟基础剑法现在已经到了瓶颈，需要触类旁通。
更何况基础剑法虽然根基扎实，可若要说威力的话，就有些差强人意了，学习一门新剑法不仅能够增强实力，也可以多一门对敌的手段。
当下孙冰不由得仔细寻找，一本本秘籍映入眼帘的：
《蕴气决》，《天地呼吸法》，《自然蓄气法》，……
一门门功法完全被孙冰忽略，在神州大地上，功法秘籍分为两类，一种是功法，另外一种是武技，但不管哪一样都是人们梦寐以求的珍宝。
功法大多则为练气功法，其中记载着人体的经脉纹路，并标注信息，教你学会如何吸收天地灵气，从而壮大自身，提升境界，每一位淬体境巅峰的人，想要突破至练气境界，必须要要一本功法。
其中少部分则是炼体功法，这种功法一直打磨身体，把身体当做武器，虽然体内也有气感，但这并不是他们的攻伐手段，传说炼体大成者，站在哪里不动，都无人能够伤害一根汗毛。
至于武技则多种多样了，虽然看起来不如功法那么重要，但却决定了你的对敌手段，况且只有武技才能把你的力量全部发挥出来。
至于孙冰的目标自然就是这武技了，练气功法被忽略之后，剩下的一半全是武技，但武技也多种多样的，分为拳法，脚法，身法，刀法，剑法等等，只要是用来攻击敌人的都是武技。
经过再一轮的筛选，最终摆在孙冰面前的仅仅只剩下两本剑法，这还是因为剑的普及性比较高，若是什么枪法，棍法的话，孙家甚至连一本都没有。
《清风剑法》，《纵横剑法》，望着面前的两本剑法，孙冰一时间他不由得有些犹豫。
《清风剑法》的主要特点是相当轻灵，需要有足够的悟性能够感知天地间风的走向，然后再以这样的风格搏杀对方，虽然攻击力不强，但胜在轻巧变化多样，若是熟练的话，甚至对方都碰不到自己的身体就将对方击毙了。
《纵横剑法》注重的就是正面搏杀，剑法凌厉，每一招每一式都是杀机，若是习此剑法的弟子掌控能力不足的话，最后甚至有可能未伤敌先伤己。
两门剑法各有优劣，说实话，孙冰其实都想要学习，毕竟他的基础剑法已经圆满，练习这些事半功倍，相信过不了多久就能够便能入门。
只不多孙冰仅仅是家族中一个普通人，虽然名义上是族长的义子，说起来还算是一个少爷呢！
可这么多年以来，他深深的知道这一层身份根本就不管用，完全没有任何特权，可以学习一门已然难得，在给他一门，哪怕孙家不把黄级下品功法放在眼中，其余弟子也会说闲话的。
不患寡而患不均，这就是人们心中的劣性，任何事情都需要一定的规章，孙冰长长叹息一口气。
这时候，功法殿中突然传来了一阵脚步声，只见楼上缓缓走下一位年轻的公子，他一身白衣，衣和发都飘飘逸逸，不扎不束，微微飘拂，哪怕是再怎么挑剔的人看到了，也只能暗称一声：贵公子。
content_en:
Although the Sun family is just an insignificant family on the entire continent, it is still quite powerful in Luoyun Town. The Kung Fu Hall is not big, but the high platform inside is full of books of simple Kung Fu. There are no less than twenty books at a glance, which makes Sun Bing a little dizzy.
According to Sun Bing's understanding, the secret books of Kung Fu are divided into four levels from high to low: Heaven, Earth, Xuan, and Huang. Each level is divided into top grade, middle grade, and low grade.
As for basic swordsmanship, it is spread throughout the entire continent, and even ordinary people can master it. It is not a secret book at all.
The place where Sun Bing stayed could only be regarded as the first floor of the Kung Fu Palace. The only items on display were yellow-level low-grade secret books, but they were enough to shock people. You must know that for ordinary people, such secret books can even be passed down from generation to generation as family heirlooms.
It is conceivable that the Sun family has a great business and is regarded as a treasure by others. In the Sun family, anyone can come in and learn a subject for free. However, it should be noted that it must not be passed on to others, otherwise it will not stop.
Sun Bing had also heard that the most profound secret book of the Sun family was a high-grade Xuan-level technique, but it required the purest bloodline to learn it, and even the branch lineage might not be able to read it, let alone those ordinary servants.
Of course, Sun Bing didn't have any extravagant expectations for that technique. The main purpose of his trip was to find a sword technique to learn. After all, the basic sword technique had reached a bottleneck and he needed to learn by analogy.
What's more, although the basic swordsmanship has a solid foundation, it is somewhat unsatisfactory in terms of power. Learning a new swordsmanship can not only enhance your strength, but also provide you with an additional method to fight against the enemy.
At this moment, Sun Bing couldn't help but search carefully, and a series of secret books came into view:
"Qi Yun Jue", "Heaven and Earth Breathing Method", "Natural Qi Accumulating Method",...
Sun Bing completely ignored all the techniques. On the land of China, the secrets of techniques are divided into two categories, one is Kung Fu and the other is martial arts, but no matter which one is a treasure that people dream of.
Most of the exercises are Qi training methods, which record the meridians of the human body and mark the information, teaching you how to absorb the spiritual energy of the world, thereby strengthening yourself and improving your realm. Everyone who is at the peak of the Body Tempering Realm must have a copy of the Qigong Techniques if they want to break through to the Qi Training realm.
A small number of them are body-refining techniques, which constantly polish the body and use the body as a weapon. Although there is a sense of Qi in the body, this is not their attack method. It is said that a person who is a master of body-refining can stand still no matter where he is, no one can hurt a hair.
As for martial arts, there are many kinds. Although they may not seem as important as Kung Fu, they determine your method of fighting the enemy. Moreover, only martial arts can bring out your full strength.
As for Sun Bing's goal, this is naturally martial arts. After Qigong training is ignored, the remaining half is all martial arts. However, martial arts are also diverse, divided into boxing, kicking, body, knife, sword, etc., as long as they are used to attack the enemy, they are all martial arts.
After another round of screening, there were only two sword techniques left in front of Sun Bing. This was because swords were relatively popular. As for marksmanship and stick techniques, the Sun family didn't even have one.
"Qingfeng Sword Technique" and "Zongheng Sword Technique". Looking at the two sword techniques in front of him, Sun Bing couldn't help but hesitate.
The main feature of "Qingfeng Sword Technique" is that it is quite light and agile. You need to have enough understanding to be able to sense the direction of the wind between heaven and earth, and then fight the opponent in this style. Although the attack power is not strong, it is more flexible and versatile. If you are skilled, you can kill the opponent without even touching your body.
"Zongheng Sword Technique" focuses on frontal combat. The sword technique is sharp and every move is a murderous move. If the disciple who practices this sword technique has insufficient control ability, he may even injure himself before injuring the enemy in the end.
Both swordsmanships have their own advantages and disadvantages. To be honest, Sun Bing actually wants to learn both. After all, his basic swordsmanship has been perfected. Practicing these will get twice the result with half the effort. I believe he will be able to get started in it in a short time.
It's just that Sun Bing is just an ordinary person in the family. Although he is nominally the adopted son of the patriarch, he is still considered a young master!
But after so many years, he knew deeply that this level of status was useless and had no privileges at all. It was already rare to be able to learn one. If he was given one, even if the Sun family did not pay attention to the low-level Huang-level skills, the other disciples would gossip.
Worrying not about scarcity but about inequality, this is the bad nature in people's minds. Everything needs certain rules. Sun Bing let out a long sigh.
At this time, there was a sudden sound of footsteps in the Kung Fu Hall, and I saw a young master slowly walking down the stairs. He was dressed in white, and his clothes and hair were flowing and flowing, not tied up, but slightly flowing. Even the most picky people could only secretly call him: "Your Majesty."
